tei:div.tei:p: ༁ྃ༁ྃ: thugs rje chen po don gsal sgron me las: brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs:

e ma ho: rnam dag spros bral chos sku'i pho brang nas: rig stong dbyer med 'od dpag med mgon gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: 'khor 'das rang grol rtogs par gsol ba 'debs: rig rtsal 'gag med 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor nas: longs spyod rdzogs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang gis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: rang snang brtan pa thob par gsol ba 'debs: sna tshogs 'gro 'dul sprul sku'i zhing khams nas: 'di'i ma phyir spyan ras gzigs thams cad la spyan ral gzigs zhes bris snang*/ de'ang gter gzhung rang gi nges tshig bshad pa dang bstun na rdzogs chen gyi gzhung rnams las lhun grub phyi rgya ral ces gsungs pa dang go ba gnad gcig /don du thugs rje yul la 'jug pa'i spyan dbye ba la dgongs pa yin 'dra bas 'gal ba med rung*/ bris pas dpe bshu dus spyan ras gzigs zhes bcos bzhag pa red pas phyi rabs rnams kyis de ltar dgongs mdzod/ mchan/ 'gro ba 'dren mdzad bram ze rnam gsum gyis: skal ldan bu la= khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par= rnga yab gling phran zangs mdog dpal ri nas: sangs rgyas kun 'dus o rgyan pad+ma yis: skal ldan= bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub par= klong yangs rnam dag rig pa'i zhing khams nas: 'brel tshad don ldan las 'phro gling pa yis: skal ldan= rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob par= rtsa khams rnam dag thig le'i dkyil 'khor nas: thugs rje'i rang bzhin zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyis: skal ldan= bskyed rdzogs mtha' ru phyin par= bal yul glang brag gsang ba'i gter gnas nas: gsang ba'i zab chos don gsal sgron me yis: skal ldan= mdo sngags bstan pa rgyas par= bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i gzhal yas nas: chos skyong srung ma gter bdag dam can gyis: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par gsol ba 'debs: bar chad gdon bgegs 'joms par gsol ba 'debs:
